question: What capacities did NFA-A and NFA-F retain at 1C?
rendered: The NFA-A variant maintained a capacity of ≈116 mAh g^− 1 at high C-rates of 1C, while the NFA-F variant delivered a low capacity of ≈81 mAh g^− 1 at the same rate.
